title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)

messages.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: part:370010 – price basis from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your offer. Our orders with you for part:370010 rose from EUR 5.26 (po:4500013373-10) to EUR 5.84 (po:4500014427-10) between 2026-01-02 and 2026-09-18. That rise is already in our price. AS-14404 fell from 3182.6744 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06) to 3007.8019 (idx:AS-14404@2026-09), a change of -5.49%. PPI-C2431 fell from 131.9 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05) to 129.1 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08), a change of -2.12%.

We know you focus on customers with volume. Our attached packages commit 23700 pieces a year for 24 or 36 months at a fixed price, which gives you secure, plannable volume without surcharge administration. Could you also tell us whether a cheaper variant of the bar is possible?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 – price basis from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. Factoring in the verified index decreases for AS-14404 and PPI-C2431, we have reduced our price to €5.30 per unit.

We appreciate your commitment to a 24-month contract; however, we must apply the AS-14404 index clause rather than a fixed price for this duration. Our primary Angebot features a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.30 per unit. This option includes a contract term of 24 months. Our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Regarding your inquiry about a cheaper variant, our technical team will evaluate the possibilities and provide an answer. From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Part 370010 – fixed-price package, 24 months
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised offer and for taking the verified data into account.

The forecast for part:370010 increased by 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

Our attached package keeps 60 days payment and commits 23700 pieces a year for 24 months at a fixed price. A fixed price gives both sides a plannable basis and saves you the monthly surcharge calculation and invoicing. As your pricing committee reviews larger changes, could you put this package to it at its next meeting? Could you also tell us whether a cheaper variant of the bar, such as a different surface finish or bar length, is possible?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Part 370010 – fixed-price package, 24 months
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We appreciate your commitment to a 24-month contract; however, we must apply the AS-14404 index clause for this duration.

Our Angebot stands at a price of €5.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision. Our technical team is currently evaluating the possibility of a cheaper variant and will provide an update shortly.

Our offer stays valid for 30 days. We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Part 370010 – revised fixed-price package for 2027-2028
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised offer and for listing the possible cost savings from a different material grade, a wider tolerance and larger lots.

We have moved our price in the attached package. It keeps the structure of our previous proposal: 60 days payment and 23700 pieces a year over 24 months. A fixed price gives both sides a plannable basis and saves you the monthly surcharge calculation and invoicing.

We will review the material grade, tolerance and lot-size options internally. Could you tell us which of them would apply without a change to the 1.4404 specification?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Part 370010 – revised fixed-price package for 2027-2028
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We appreciate your revised offer and your movement on price. As we strive to support your requirements with our reliable service and broad product range, we have reviewed your request carefully.

As previously stated, we must maintain the AS-14404 index clause for a 24-month contract, but we can reduce our base price to €5.00 per unit. Therefore, our offer stands at a price of €5.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our offer stays valid for 7 days.

Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.10 per unit, a price of €5.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Regarding your technical question, wider tolerances and larger lot sizes would apply without changing the 1.4404 specification. From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
